title: Contractive kinetic Langevin samplers beyond global Lipschitz continuity
abstract: arXiv:2509.12031v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: In this paper, we examine the problem of sampling from log-concave distributions with (possibly) superlinear gradient growth under kinetic (underdamped) Langevin algorithms. Using a carefully tailored taming scheme, we propose two novel discretizations of the kinetic Langevin SDE, the tamed exponential euler scheme and tamed OBABO and we show that they are both contractive and satisfy a log-Sobolev inequality. Building on this, we establish a series of non-asymptotic bounds in $2$-Wasserstein and total variation distance between the law reached by each algorithm and the underlying target measure. In particular, we show that both algorithms can reach almost optimal $\tilde{\mathcal{O}}(\epsilon^{-1})$ convergence rate in Wasserstein and Total Variation distances, and $\tilde{\mathcal{O}}(\epsilon^{-\frac{1}{2}})$ under increased Hessian local regularity for the tamed OBABO scheme.

translated_title: 超越全局Lipschitz连续性的收缩动力学朗之万采样器
translated_abstract: 本文研究了在对数凹分布（其梯度可能呈超线性增长）上使用动力学（欠阻尼）朗之万算法进行采样的问题。通过精心设计的驯化方案，我们提出了动力学朗之万随机微分方程的两种新颖离散化方法：驯化指数欧拉格式和驯化OBABO格式，并证明二者均具有收缩性且满足对数Sobolev不等式。在此基础上，我们建立了每种算法所达到的分布与目标测度之间在2-Wasserstein距离和全变差距离下的一系列非渐近界。特别地，我们证明两种算法在Wasserstein距离和全变差距离下均可达到接近最优的Õ(ε⁻¹)收敛速率，且驯化OBABO格式在Hessian局部正则性增强的条件下可达到Õ(ε⁻¹ᐟ²)的收敛速率。
tldr: 本文提出两种驯化离散化的动力学朗之万采样器（驯化指数欧拉格式与驯化OBABO格式），突破了全局Lipschitz连续性的限制，可处理梯度超线性增长的对数凹分布采样，并证明其在Wasserstein和全变差距离下可达接近最优的Õ(ε⁻¹)收敛速率。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes two novel tamed discretizations of kinetic Langevin samplers (tamed exponential Euler and tamed OBABO) that go beyond global Lipschitz continuity to handle log-concave distributions with superlinear gradient growth, achieving near-optimal convergence rates of Õ(ε⁻¹) in Wasserstein and total variation distances.
